title: Restricted regular coefficient modules on the finite-field tail
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, $E\subseteq F\subseteq\Omega$ finite intermediate fields, and $X$ a scheme. Use the specified coefficient maps $E_X\to F_X$ and $E_X\to\Omega_X$ [def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map], [def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map]. Define the stage module to be the regular $F_X$-module restricted along $E_X\to F_X$, and the vertex module to be the regular $\Omega_X$-module restricted along $E_X\to\Omega_X$, both viewed as sectionwise $E_X$-module sheaves under the underlying-sheaf-preserving equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. These are definitions of the objects only; no colimit assertion is included.
